translations.web: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
translations.bsb: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.
translations.kjv: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent
translations.asv: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.
